passages.note: Senate Floor vote (carried 'By Wiener') shows him among the Ayes, 31-0, with zero Noes at every Senate stage.

passages.provision_quote: The right to marry is a fundamental right.
passages.note: Chaptered text repeals the one-man-one-woman marriage provision and declares marriage a fundamental right, with no anti-discrimination or religious-exemption clause attached.

rows.reasoning: Wiener is recorded voting Aye at every Senate stage of ACA 5 (2023-2024), including the Senate Floor passage he carried ('By Wiener'), a single-subject constitutional amendment whose operative text declares 'The right to marry is a fundamental right,' repealing the one-man-one-woman marriage definition with no accompanying anti-discrimination or religious-exemption clause. Per the annex, a measure that secures the right to marry with no anti-discrimination clause meets every clause of rung 2 ('the same benefits and protections as any other marriage'), and the near-unanimous Senate vote is corroborated by the bill's own chair-shaped text.
